entities.name: Diego de Arce y Reinoso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diego de Arce y Reinoso Ávila y Palomares was a Spanish bishop who served as Grand Inquisitor of Spain from 1643 to 1665; and as Bishop of Plasencia (1640–1652), Bishop of Ávila (1637–1640), and Bishop of Tui (1635–1637).
